# Metabo Drops

> Metabo Drops is a Metabolism Support Drops. Metabo Drops is a liquid supplement you add to your daily coffee to support metabolism, natural energy, and fat-burning. The drops are designed to blend easily into your morning brew, turning it into a metabolism-supporting drink. The product comes with a 60-day money-back guarantee.
